families.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength
families._definition: frightening because of an awareness of danger

members.tone: The mildest force here — fear pinned to a danger you can recognise, which makes it a warning rather than the sheer horror of *horrifying*.
members._gloss: frightening because of an awareness of danger

members.tone: Consternation at full weight — it knocks the composure sideways, where *dismaying* only unsettles it.
members._gloss: causing consternation

members.tone: The gentler consternation: spirits sink rather than reel, and the thing is not condemned outright as *appalling* condemns it.
members._gloss: causing consternation

members.tone: Condemns as much as it describes — the horror is charged to the thing as a fault, where *horrifying* only reports the effect.
members._gloss: provoking horror

members.tone: Fright rather than full horror — the same sense worn lightly enough to sound almost decorous beside *horrifying*.
members._gloss: provoking horror

members.tone: Keeps the verb's live action, the thing doing the horrifying to you as you watch, where *horrible* merely names the quality.
members._gloss: provoking horror

members.tone: The plain, all-purpose word for the quality — it states the horror without staging it.
members._gloss: provoking horror

members.tone: Nothing to do with looks here: a blunt, unadorned word for what provokes horror, and the flatness is the whole of its force.
members._gloss: provoking horror

members.tone: Broad and unspecific — it names the terror without picturing it, where *fearsome* gives the thing a shape.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: Grave and flat, treating the terror as a settled fact of the situation with none of the flourish of *direful*.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: The heightened form, reaching for a weight that *dire* carries without effort.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: Elevated, almost ceremonial — the terror is stated as an attribute the thing simply has, not an effect it works on you.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: The participle turns the fear around: the thing is defined by the dread already aimed at it, where *dreadful* says it causes dread.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: Says plainly that the thing causes dread — the workaday partner to *dread*'s elevation.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: Points outward at what causes the fear rather than inward at whoever feels it, the opposite reading to the one the word's shape invites.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

members.tone: Concedes stature to what frightens — the terror it names is formidable, not merely nasty as in *horrible*.
members._gloss: causing fear or dread or terror

families.axis: lasts a long while → never ends
families._definition: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place

members.tone: Flat and factual — the bare statement that a condition holds, without the warmth *lasting* can pick up.
members._gloss: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place

members.tone: Softer than *permanent* — duration sounds like something the thing has rather than a status fixed onto it.
members._gloss: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place

members.tone: Makes long duration sound like constancy, where *enduring* makes it sound like resistance.
members._gloss: lasting a long time

members.tone: Long duration framed as strength, as though the thing had to hold out to reach it.
members._gloss: lasting a long time

members.tone: The strongest of the long-lasting three: not holding out like *enduring* but beyond decay altogether, which treats what it names as worth keeping.
members._gloss: lasting a long time

members.tone: Presents going on indefinitely as something to be envied rather than merely measured, where *perpetual* only records the running on.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Lofty and bookish — endlessness stated in the grandest available terms with no judgement attached to it.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Carries the same elevated, uncommitted weight as *aeonian*, adding nothing and softening nothing.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Solemn and absolute — it makes endlessness a property of the thing rather than a stretch of time, and still approves of nothing.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Warmer than *eternal* — the endlessness sounds like something held onto rather than a fact declared.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Endlessness as plain mechanism, running on without the grandeur *eternal* brings to the same span.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Frames endlessness as the plain absence of a stop, without the grandeur *eternal* brings or the warmth of *everlasting*.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely

members.tone: Presses on the missing pause, so what continues indefinitely reads as relentless rather than simply long.
members._gloss: continuing forever or indefinitely
used of decisions and contracts
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: Positional rather than evaluative — it marks a thing as kept ready for whatever comes instead of raised for one occasion.
members._gloss: not created for a particular occasion

families.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour
families._definition: having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease

members.tone: The flat baseline of the family, a verdict passed on body or mind alike with none of the visible glow *rosy* insists on.
members._gloss: having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease

members.tone: Reads health off the skin's colour instead of declaring it, offering evidence where *healthy* offers a judgement.
members._gloss: having the pinkish flush of health

members.tone: Puts the same pink flush in one place, the cheeks, which turns *flushed*'s observation into a portrait.
members._gloss: having the pinkish flush of health

members.tone: The single unadorned stroke of the pink-flush words, letting the glow stand alone rather than pinning it to a face as *rosy-cheeked* does.
members._gloss: having the pinkish flush of health

members.tone: Spells out where *rosy*'s glow sits, and the extra word makes it fonder and more picturesque.
members._gloss: having the pinkish flush of health

members.tone: Health with energy spilling out of it, so where *healthy* reports a condition this one moves.
members._gloss: vigorously healthy

members.tone: Judges health by touch, tone and resilience in the tissue itself, not the colour *rosy* shows nor the vigour *bouncing* spends.
members._gloss: possessing the tone and resiliency of healthy tissue

members.tone: The unshowy top of the scale, excellent condition stated without a flourish where *hale* reaches for one.
members._gloss: in excellent physical condition

members.tone: Says the same excellent condition as *good* with the ring of a verdict rather than a compliment.
members._gloss: in excellent physical condition

members.tone: Formal and a little grand, and it covers vigour regained as readily as vigour never lost.
members._gloss: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health

members.tone: Frames that same vigorous health as entirety, leaning on the restored side where *hale* leans on the display.
members._gloss: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health

members.tone: Approves through appetite, abundance taken with relish, so it praises how someone eats rather than how they are.
members._gloss: consuming abundantly and with gusto

members.tone: Treats great health of body or mind as something carried in the constitution, possessed as much as shown.
members._gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health

members.tone: Pitches the same great bodily or mental health as raw force, louder and more physical than *full-blooded*.
members._gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health

members.tone: Sounds like a boast, great health of body or mind worn as vitality rather than merely reported as *healthy* would.
members._gloss: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health

members.tone: Clinical and purely negative in shape, saying only that jaundice is absent and carrying none of the approval the rest of the family trades in.
members._gloss: not affected by jaundice

families.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt
families._definition: serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting controversy

members.tone: The neutral base of the family - it names the power to excite, stimulate or set off controversy without settling whether that is welcome, where *provoking* fixes the reaction as anger.
members._gloss: serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting co

members.tone: Flat and clinical for what it describes, labelling a thing as anger-producing by disposition rather than catching the anger or resentment in the act.
members._gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment

members.tone: The participle keeps the effect live - anger and resentment being stirred now, where *agitative* states a settled property.
members._gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment

members.tone: Blunt and personal beside the clinical *agitative* - the anger or resentment it names is felt as an affront by someone in particular.
members._gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment

members.tone: The disturbance is set before you as something to be met, so the discomfort arrives with a demand attached rather than a verdict.
members._gloss: disturbingly provocative

members.tone: Here the disturbance pulls instead of repelling - what unsettles is also what fascinates, where *challenging* wants an answer out of you.
members._gloss: disturbingly provocative

members.tone: Names a load waiting to go off, the violent feeling or the controversy stored in the thing and not yet released, where *inflammatory* names something already doing the work.
members._gloss: capable of producing violent emotion or arousing controversy

members.tone: Carries the image of a fire set on purpose, so stirring people to act or to rise is treated as damage waiting to happen.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: A bare, near-technical label for the same power to move people to action or revolt, with none of the heat *incendiary* puts under it.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: The heat is the whole point - it treats the thing as what sets the action or the rebellion alight, not merely the occasion for it.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: Points past the blaze to the hand behind it, naming what starts the action or the rising rather than how fiercely it burns.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: Contempt running both ways - it belittles those stirred to act as a mob and denies the stirring any cause worth having.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: The gravest word here - it treats rousing people to action or revolt as an offence against authority, where *incendiary* only warns of the fire.
members._gloss: arousing to action or rebellion

members.tone: The one stirring in the family that is welcome, though the spurring and goading in it keep an edge of being driven to act rather than persuaded.
members._gloss: rousing to activity or heightened action as by spurring or goading

families.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing
families._definition: without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success

members.tone: The family's plain verdict, hope absent because no comfort or success looks possible — a reading of the odds where *despairing* is a reading of the feeling.
members._gloss: without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success

members.tone: The most degrading member: utter resignation or hopelessness worn openly, so that the giving-up is itself what gets judged.
members._gloss: showing utter resignation or hopelessness

members.tone: A bare negation covering the same utter resignation or hopelessness as *abject*, but with the contempt drained out and understatement left to carry it.
members._gloss: showing utter resignation or hopelessness

members.tone: Paints the little-or-no hope rather than measuring it, and paints it unrelieved, which is what puts it past *dim*.
members._gloss: offering little or no hope

members.tone: The same shortage of hope felt as bareness and exposure rather than as the darkness of *black*.
members._gloss: offering little or no hope

members.tone: The mildest of the three, since it sits on the “little” rather than the “no” — hope faint but not yet out.
members._gloss: offering little or no hope

members.tone: Points at the despair itself, whether a thing arises from that loss of hope or merely bears its mark, where *hopeless* points at the prospects.
members._gloss: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope

members.tone: The straining side of the same despair — something arising from lost hope rather than merely showing it, so it pushes where *despairing* only mourns.
members._gloss: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope

members.tone: A sunk, settled state with hope gone or all but gone, heavier than *dim* and far quieter than *desperate*.
members._gloss: without or almost without hope

members.tone: Puts that same absent-or-nearly-absent hope in the body, a sickness felt rather than the low weight of *despondent*.
members._gloss: without or almost without hope

members.tone: Hopelessness that is marked or shown in a way inviting pity, not the reproach *abject* invites.
members._gloss: marked by or showing hopelessness

members.tone: Turns the loss forward — neither prospect nor hope of a future — a flat structural verdict beside the mood of *forlorn*.
members._gloss: having no prospect or hope of a future

members.tone: Two failures at once, no power to function and no help at hand, which makes it sound like a plea rather than the verdict *hopeless* delivers.
members._gloss: unable to function; without help

members.tone: Carries the same inability and the same want of help as *helpless*, but as a settled condition rather than a moment of one, so it sounds past rescue.
members._gloss: unable to function; without help

members.tone: The member aimed at what admits no solution rather than at anyone, a flat statement that none is to be hoped for, carrying no reproach of its own.
members._gloss: without hope of solution

families.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind
families._definition: not serious in content or attitude or behavior

members.tone: The family's plain term and its widest, attaching to content, attitude or behaviour alike without the picture of a hollow head that the compounds beside it supply.
members._gloss: not serious in content or attitude or behavior

members.tone: Blunt mockery that explains the unseriousness by putting air where the thinking should be, where *frivolous* just reports the lack.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: Whirl rather than vacancy, the lightest hit in the group and closer to teasing than to the contempt in *empty-headed*.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: Mockery that goes past unseriousness to vacancy - it does not merely find the person frivolous but alleges there is nothing inside to be serious with, where *dizzy* only sets the head spinning.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: Mockery by weighing the brain, making the frivolity ridiculous rather than merely noting it as *silly* does.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: Lightness with a lift to it, the unseriousness felt as high spirits, so it stings far less than *empty-headed*.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: The same charge as *giddy* stated as a property of the head rather than a mood, and a light head is still not the vacant one *empty-headed* alleges.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: The unhyphenated twin of *light-headed*, identical in force: a light head, not an empty one.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: The plainest and most forgiving word for the fault, naming the frivolity without a metaphor for the head and leaving room for fondness that *airheaded* forecloses.
members._gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity

members.tone: Whim read as unreliability, so it warns about conduct where *head-in-the-clouds* only pictures a drift.
members._gloss: guided by whim and fancy

members.tone: The lightest reading of a life run by whim and fancy: loose and ungoverned rather than a fault to be answered for.
members._gloss: guided by whim and fancy

members.tone: Indulgent almost to fondness, the whim and fancy carrying the person off rather than damning them, unlike *scatterbrained*'s charge of disorder.
members._gloss: guided by whim and fancy

members.tone: Whim as scatter: the fault is that attention will not hold together, which *flighty* leaves as mere changeability.
members._gloss: guided by whim and fancy

members.tone: The verdict is built in, the levity being out of place, so the word rebukes a manner rather than diagnosing a mind as *empty-headed* does.
members._gloss: showing inappropriate levity

members.tone: The measured version of *flippant*'s fault, locating the misplaced levity in a cast of mind instead of throwing it back at the offender.
members._gloss: showing inappropriate levity

members.tone: It runs to two things at once, the silly and the trivial, so the dismissal is as much about weightlessness as about foolishness.
members._gloss: silly or trivial

families.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down
families._definition: determining or having the power to determine an outcome

members.tone: The family's plain baseline, covering both the thing that actually determines an outcome and the thing merely holding the power to, and taking no view on how the outcome falls.
members._gloss: determining or having the power to determine an outcome

members.tone: The plainest member — the power or quality of deciding stated with no formality at all, where *determinative* says as much in a starched collar.
members._gloss: having the power or quality of deciding

members.tone: Formal and analytic, naming the deciding power as a property a factor holds rather than anything it is seen to do.
members._gloss: having the power or quality of deciding

members.tone: Formal, and tilted toward deciding as a standing quality, where *determining* is that same power caught in the act.
members._gloss: having the power or quality of deciding

members.tone: The deciding power shown in use rather than merely held, which gives it a motion *determinant* lacks.
members._gloss: having the power or quality of deciding

members.tone: Adds gravity to plain importance — consequences big enough to feel handed down, with a shadow across them that *deciding* has no room for.
members._gloss: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance

members.tone: The darkest way this family has of saying momentous — it makes decisive importance sound like doom arriving, where *fateful* only makes it weighty.
members._gloss: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance

members.tone: Force with no courtesy in it: rather than settle an outcome it slams the door on debate and action alike, leaving nothing to answer.
members._gloss: putting an end to all debate or action

families.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault
families._definition: having a body or a body of a specified kind; often used in combination

members.tone: The unmarked base of the set - it says only that a body is there, or that one of a stated kind is, and waits for a word in front of it to say which.
members._gloss: having a body or a body of a specified kind; often used in combination

members.tone: The one member that treats embodiment as something conferred rather than measured, and it carries a gravity the shape words never reach for.

members.tone: Praises suppleness rather than outline - where *slim-bodied* reports a shape, this admires the ease of one.

members.tone: Measures across where *long-bodied* measures along, and is just as uncommitted about whether narrowness is a virtue.

members.tone: Names a whole outline instead of one dimension - the most purely geometric word here and the least interested in judging what it draws.
members._gloss: having an oval body

members.tone: The mirror of *long-bodied* and just as flat - shortness is given as a proportion, not held against the thing that has it.

members.tone: Names the colour flatly, letting the metal's name stand in for the shade.

members.tone: The suffix softens the same colour into resemblance - a sheen suggested where *silver-bodied* names the shade outright.
members._gloss: having a silver-colored body

members.tone: Slimness stated with quiet approval - the plainest of the favourable three, complimentary without reaching for grace.
members._gloss: having a slim body

members.tone: The same slimness with the compliment drained out - where *slim-bodied* approves, this can land as merely scant.
members._gloss: having a slim body

members.tone: The most admiring way to report slimness, lending it an elegance *thin-bodied* withholds.
members._gloss: having a slim body

members.tone: Reports surface rather than dimension, and the agreeableness in it belongs to the texture rather than to any verdict on the body.
members._gloss: having a smooth body

members.tone: The one dimension word here that can land as a verdict instead of a measurement, reading as bulk where *slim-bodied* reads as trim.
members._gloss: having a thick body

families.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

members.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

members.tone: Openly contemptuous rather than merely absolute - it disparages the thing it magnifies, where *complete* only measures it.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

members.tone: Totalizes with an air of accomplishment, as though the quality had been brought to a finish, and that mismatch gives it a wryness *utter* has none of.

members.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Carries exasperation into the intensifier, insisting the quality will not let up, where *utter* simply fixes its extent.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

members.tone: The most deliberate of these amplifiers, spelling out that nothing has been mixed in to weaken the quality where *pure* asserts it in a breath.
members._gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

families.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards
families._definition: not suitable or right or appropriate

members.tone: The flattest disapproval here - it marks a thing as not fitting without naming the standard it fails, where *unseemly* and *indecent* both point at one.

members.tone: Blunt and severe where *indecorous* is measured - the same breach of what polite society accepts, named with nothing held back.

members._gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

members.tone: Measures the breach against whoever commits it - the conduct falls below what suits them, where *indecorous* faults the conduct alone.
members._gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

members.tone: Faint and formal - it registers the breach of accepted standards as unattractive rather than shocking, staying well back from *indecent*.
members._gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

members.tone: Firm and plain-spoken: the conduct does not fit at all, which is more pointed than *indecorous* and less scandalized than *indecent*.
members._gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

members.tone: The most restrained of this set, glancing at the breach rather than rebuking it as *unseemly* does.
members._gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

members.tone: Mild in shape but broad in reach - it runs from merely improper right through to offensive, and the understatement is what makes the far end land.

members._gloss: improper or even offensive

members.tone: Purely a measure against established usage or procedure - it records a mismatch rather than passing judgement, which is what separates it from *improper*.

members.tone: Cooler and more technical than *wrong* - the same failure to accord with established procedure, stated as a matter of record.

families.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact
families._definition: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds

members.tone: The unmarked term for expecting the best, and the only one here that neither congratulates the expectation nor doubts it.

members.tone: Positional rather than evaluative: it names an expectation that prices will rise, taking no view of the person holding it the way *optimistic* does.

members.tone: Leads with the pleasantness and leaves the unrealism in the background, where *pollyannaish* brings it to the front.

members._gloss: pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic

members.tone: Buoyant and forward-leaning where *cheerful* is merely pleasant, and it carries the least doubt of the three.

members.tone: Puts the optimism into what is being shown rather than into the one holding it, so it colours a view instead of judging a temperament.

members.tone: The shorter, warmer form beside *rose-colored*, and the readier of the two to stand as simple praise for how a prospect looks.

members.tone: The heavier, more formal twin of *sanguine* for the same confident cheer, the weight falling on the word rather than the mood.

families.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down
families._definition: affected or marked by low spirits

members.tone: The plain, unmarked word for the state - it reports low spirits without the finality of *amort* or the weather of *gloomy*.

members.tone: Identical in sense to *chopfallen*, and like it stresses being brought low - a spirit put down from a height rather than one that was always down.

members.tone: The blunter-sounding twin of *chapfallen*: the force is in the fall, not in the level reached.

members.tone: Implies the spirit stood higher before it was lowered, which *gloomy* and *low* do not.

members.tone: Suffuses rather than strikes - the despondency reads as a settled climate around the person, where *deflated* reads as one blow.

members.tone: Hard-edged where *gloomy* is merely overcast - melancholy that has set and will not be coaxed out of.
members._gloss: filled with melancholy and despondency

members.tone: The softest word here - it makes despondency sound like a passing shade, understating what the sense actually covers.
members._gloss: filled with melancholy and despondency
